description: This file is a controller class for managing GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) related functionalities within the OpenCart admin panel. It handles displaying GDPR requests, filtering, listing, and actions such as approve, deny, and delete for GDPR requests.

classes.name: GDPR
classes.description: Controller class for GDPR management in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that sets up the GDPR page, including loading language data, setting title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of GDPR entries, returning the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares GDPR request data, handles filtering, pagination, and generates the GDPR list view.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles the approval of GDPR requests, updating their status accordingly.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles the denial of GDPR requests, updating their status to denied.
